Market Analysis
Read the precious-metals market the way professionals do — fundamental drivers, technical patterns, and global event triggers.
Most retail buyers react to price. Professionals read the conditions that move it — real yields, central-bank flows, currency strength, mine supply, industrial demand, and the chart structure that reveals where conviction sits. This path closes the gap between watching the spot price tick and understanding the forces behind each move.
By the end, you will be able to form your own view on gold and silver instead of borrowing one from headlines. You will know which indicators actually predict moves, which patterns are noise, and how a single geopolitical event can repprice the metals overnight. That foundation lets you time entries, size positions, and hold through volatility with a thesis you can defend.
📊
What you'll learn
How to separate signal from noise across fundamental, technical, and macro data
The specific indicators that drive gold and silver pricing — and the ones that don’t
How to read charts for trend, support, resistance, and momentum shifts
How global events translate into precious-metals price action, often within hours
What’s in this path
Reading Market Trends
— Identify primary, secondary, and short-term trends so you stop trading against the dominant direction.
Fundamental Analysis
— Evaluate the supply, demand, and monetary forces that set a floor and ceiling on metals prices.
Technical Analysis
— Use price action, volume, and key chart patterns to time entries and exits with discipline.
Economic Indicators
— Track real interest rates, inflation prints, employment data, and dollar strength as leading signals for gold and silver.
Global Events & Their Impact
— Anticipate how wars, elections, central-bank decisions, and trade shocks reprice precious metals in real time.
Reading Market Trends
A practical framework for identifying upward trends, consolidations, and reversals in precious metals using price action, volume, and sentiment indicators.
Fundamental Analysis
How to read supply, demand, monetary policy, and geopolitical forces to value gold and silver beyond short-term price moves.
Technical Analysis
How to read precious metals charts using trend, support and resistance, moving averages, momentum indicators, volume, and pattern recognition.
Economic Indicators
How Fed policy, inflation data, currency moves, and employment figures transmit through to gold and silver prices in 2025.
Global Events & Their Impact
How geopolitical tensions, trade wars, supply chain realignment, and economic warfare shape precious metals prices and investor demand.
